A New Pill Could Reduce the Risk of Having a Second Stroke

On November 9, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved a new type of medication to reduce the risk of strokes in certain populations. Asundexian, which will be sold under the brand name Sunharbo, is a daily pill that is the first to target a specific factor in the blood-clotting process that can contribute to stroke.
